question: In a certain code language, ‘ENDED’ is coded as ‘GRJMN’. What is the code for ‘PLAYS’ in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘ENDED’ is coded as ‘GRJMN’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0232e166fbea501da7fdb71161ecd180c1172211d517ecdaafa5404828c0e69f.png] 

Similarly, for 'PLAYS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/747a74a53a71c1e1168fc4a956facc11c8022933583c072117b7da7be8e56c8e.png] 

So, 'PLAYS' is coded as 'RPGGC'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
